description: Vulnerability in the Helidon product of Oracle Fusion Middleware (component: Imperative Web Server).  Supported versions that are affected are 3.0.0-3.2.18. Difficult to exploit vulnerability allows unauthenticated attacker with network access via HTTP to compromise Helidon.  Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in  unauthorized access to critical data or complete access to all Helidon accessible data. CVSS 3.1 Base Score 5.9 (Confidentiality impacts).  CVSS Vector: (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:N).
